estense-karl-v-1542.summary: The Emperor tells his viceroy of Sicily that the island cannot pay for its infantry, its galleys and La Goleta without help and that none can come from his other kingdoms; that La Goleta must be provided for because of the Turkish fleet; that the spies report the main French effort coming to the frontier of Perpignan, with a threat to Navarre; and that the count of Novellara's pay and the Viscount Cicala's galleys must be paid.
estense-karl-v-1542.en:
This follows the Spanish reading, with the same holes.

Bold text is cipher, and plain text is clear in the letter. A word in [?word] is doubtful, and [...] is a stretch I cannot read.

The King

Illustrious Prince, cousin, our Viceroy and Captain General. After writing to you on the 13th of last month, we received your letter of 20 June, in which you give us a particular account of the patrimony and its state, of the needs of that kingdom, and of the great burdens there beyond the ordinary, especially in the upkeep of the infantry, the galleys and La Goleta, declaring to us that they cannot be sustained without relief from elsewhere.

All of which we have seen and understood, and in reporting it in such detail you show well the care you take of our service and of the good of that kingdom.

system: Each base sign is a consonant and a small digit above it adds the vowel (1 to 5 and 6 to 0 each run a, e, i, o, u); a sign with no digit is a single letter; a further sign marks a doubled or palatal consonant.
